description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmailQueueService in the OrangeHRM system, testing email queue functionalities such as adding emails to the queue, sending emails, resetting services, changing mail status, and processing pending mails.

classes.name: EmailQueueServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing EmailQueueService functionalities within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmailQueueService instance and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Verifies that getEmailQueueDao returns an instance of EmailQueueDao.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Tests that getEmailService is called within EmailQueueService.

methods.name: testAddToQueue
methods.description: Tests adding an email to the queue and validates the Mail object properties.

methods.name: testSendSingleMail
methods.description: Mocks email sending process for a single mail and verifies the sequence of method calls.

methods.name: testResetEmailService
methods.description: Tests resetting the email service by setting message properties.

methods.name: testChangeMailStatus
methods.description: Checks status changes of Mail object, including setting sent timestamp.

methods.name: testSendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Tests processing of all pending mails, mocking database retrieval and ensuring individual mail sending occurs.
